text_block_list.text:
Whoa, we're already back at the
academy! Today
went by in a flash!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Huh? Isn't that...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Isn't that... Эйр Грув? It looks like she's
heading
our way!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
What if she's found out that it was me
who placed
the whoopee cushions in the
student council
office?!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: What did you do that for?!

text_block_list.text:
Don't get the wrong idea! It was a spell!
If
successful, it's supposed to give you
courage!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Still, I can't have her finding out the
truth! If she
does, the spell becomes a
curse!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Trainer... Nay! Divine Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I entrust this life of mine into your care!
Please do
well by me!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Having said that, Матиканэфукукитару
quickly
darts away, hiding out of sight.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Where did Fukukitaru get off to? I swear
I just
saw her over here...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Is that so... Then, could you pass on this
message
for me?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I'd prefer to tell her in person, but I have
an
emergency meeting to get to. I'm
afraid I can't
spare the time.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Please tell her I said... thank you.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
This morning at the dorm, she forced this
hole
punch into my hands with all this
talk that it was
my lucky item.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I wasn't sure I believed in

fortune-telling, but thanks to her, I was
able to
prepare for my upcoming
meeting effectively.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
That being said, her usual reckless
behavior is not
acceptable. She
shouldn't get carried away.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Tell her that for me too.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list: ...And that's what Эйр Грув had to say.

text_block_list.text: Urk... Sniffle...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Wahhh! I'm so happy!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Having someone validate my
divinations... It's like
I'm being validated
too!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: I know why this happened...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
It's because I put myself at risk placing
all those
whoopee cushions! I'm sure of
it!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: Try not to overdo it, okay?

text_block_list.text:
Sure! I don't really understand what you
mean,
but I'll try not to!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Over there?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Gah! You traitooor!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's with the attitude? I'm only
here to
thank you for this morning.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Thank me? Oh, are you talking
about the
lucky item?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right. Thanks to that hole
punch you
gave me—
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Oh, so that's what it was! I thought you
found out
that it was me who planted all
the whoopee
cushions last week!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Oh? So that was your doing?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Oops...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Why don't the two of us go to the
student council
office now so everyone
can... thank you... for you
contributions?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Arghh! Someone save meee!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
...Well, she's on her way to retrieve the
whoopee
cushions at least.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I accompany Матиканэфукукитару to
accept
everyone's "thanks."
text_block_list.name: Монолог
